task: Place the MEDICINE_BOTTLE on MEDICAL_TABLE after removing the obstacle in front of the CAR.
plan_summary: Remove the FRONT_CRATE obstacle by placing it on TEMP_ZONE, then navigate to pick up the MEDICINE_BOTTLE and place it on the MEDICAL_TABLE.
assumptions: FRONT_CRATE is the obstacle in front of CAR.
TEMP_ZONE is a valid location to place the removed obstacle.
CAR can reach MEDICINE_BOTTLE and MEDICAL_TABLE via NavTo within tolerance.
